title: claim_task input
description: Claim a task for a lease. Pass thread_id to claim that task, or board_id (and optional labels) to claim the oldest ready task: tasks kept for you first, then unassigned ones. wait_seconds (up to 25) waits for a task to become ready. Returns the claim's token: renew it with renew_task before the lease ends, and pass it to update_task to complete, fail, release or block.

wait_seconds.description: With board_id: wait this long for a matching task to become ready

lease_seconds.description: Lease length in seconds, up to the server's task_lease_seconds (the default)
